verdict.rationale: Logseq's local HTTP API server supports external access "through authorization" using user-created bearer tokens, so a user can issue a credential an agent can present. However, the evidence shows no scoping: the single POST /api endpoint dispatches any plugin API method, and nothing indicates per-token permissions, read-only modes or graph/page restrictions. Missing for 10: per-token permission scopes, read-only or write-limited tokens, restriction to specific graphs or pages, token expiry/rotation documentation, independent corroboration.
